brief:
The Al-Majd Al-Amni platform, affiliated with Palestinian resistance security, issued a warning against increasing Palestinian citizen interactions with Israeli intelligence officers' social media accounts, Shehab Wire reported. The platform called on Palestinians to avoid commenting on or engaging with such accounts in any form.

The alert comes as the platform cited growing activity by Palestinian citizens on posts from Israeli intelligence personnel across social media networks, signaling concern over potential security risks from such digital exchanges.
